calendarFaqs.q: Which Durham Public Schools calendar should families use?
calendarFaqs.a: Most DPS students follow the traditional calendar shown on this page. Year-round schools and Cooperative Innovative High School programs use separate calendars, so families in those programs should use the matching official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does DPS have early release days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The DPS traditional calendar lists early release days on October 7 and December 9, 2026, and February 24, May 12, and June 9, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Are teacher workdays no-school days for DPS students?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Teacher workdays and required teacher workdays listed on the traditional student calendar are no-school days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I check for last-minute DPS calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official DPS district calendars page and announcements from your student's school. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and does not automatically receive district changes.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: School starts one day earlier, on August 24 instead of August 25.
The last day also moves one day earlier, to June 9 instead of June 10.
Spring break is more than a week earlier, moving from March 30–April 6 to March 22–26.
The traditional calendar includes five student early release days.
